## 1. Practice Philosophy & Clinical Standards
Joint Clinic is built upon the premise that every joint preservation and reconstruction must meet the exacting standards of tertiary institutions in New Delhi. Rather than rushing into surgery, Dr. Gaurav Bhargava practices an evidence-based clinical ladder:
1. Precise Digital Imaging & Biomechanical Assessment
2. Conservative Rehabilitation & Lifestyle Modification
3. Biologic & Regenerative Interventions (PRP, Viscosupplementation)
4. Minimally Invasive Keyhole Arthroscopic Surgery
5. High-Precision Primary & Revision Arthroplasty (Knee and Hip Replacement)

## 4. In-Depth Clinical Procedures & Treatments (Common Names)

### 4.1 Knee Replacement Surgery (Total & Partial TKR)
- Target Conditions: Severe Grade 3 and Grade 4 Knee Osteoarthritis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Post-Traumatic Arthritis, Severe Genu Varum (Bow Legs) or Valgum (Knock Knees).
- Technique: Subvastus muscle-sparing approach that minimizes trauma to the quadriceps tendon.
- Implants: High-flexion, biocompatible cobalt-chromium or oxidized zirconium femoral components with highly cross-linked polyethylene inserts.
- Anesthesia: Combined spinal-epidural anesthesia with ultrasound-guided adductor canal block for continuous pain relief without motor weakness.
- Rapid Recovery Protocol:
  - Day 1 (Within 24 Hours): Guided standing and walking with standard walker under physical therapy supervision.
  - Day 3–5: Discharge to home with independent bed transfers and safe toilet access.
  - Week 1–2: Transition from standard walker to elbow crutch or stick inside the residence.
  - Week 4–6: Unassisted walking, stair climbing, resumption of light driving and non-strenuous desk employment.
  - Month 3: Full structural remodeling, pain-free routine walks, travel, and prolonged standing.

### 4.2 Hip Replacement Surgery (THR)
- Target Conditions: Avascular Necrosis (AVN) of Femoral Head (Stages III & IV), Osteoarthritis of the Hip, Ankylosing Spondylitis, Femoral Neck Non-Union Fractures.
- Technique: Uncemented press-fit femoral stem and acetabular cup, promoting natural osteointegration.
- Bearing Surfaces: Ceramic-on-Ceramic or Ceramic-on-Crosslinked Polyethylene offering ultra-low friction, maximum longevity, and reduced risk of osteolysis.

### 4.3 Sports Injury & ACL Treatment (Keyhole Knee Surgery)
- Keyhole minimally invasive visualization using 4mm fiberoptic arthroscopes.
- Indications: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Tears, Posterior Cruciate Ligament (PCL) Tears, Meniscal Tears, Cartilage Loose Bodies.
- Techniques: Anatomic quadrupled hamstring or bone-patellar-tendon-bone autograft ACL reconstruction; meniscus repair using all-inside suture anchors versus partial meniscectomy. Fast athletic return to running and competitive fitness.

### 4.4 Shoulder & Rotator Cuff Treatment
- Keyhole shoulder repair for torn rotator cuff tendons, recurrent shoulder pop-outs (Bankart repair), and frozen shoulder with suture anchors.

### 4.5 PRP Therapy & Joint Pain Care (Non-Surgical Cartilage Protection)
- Indications: Mild-to-moderate (Grade 1 & 2) Knee Osteoarthritis, Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy, Tennis Elbow, Plantar Fasciitis.
- Method: Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma centrifuged under sterile conditions and injected directly intra-articularly to reduce synovial inflammation, stimulate chondrocyte repair, and delay surgical intervention for years.

### 4.6 Bone Fracture & Trauma Care
- 24/7 emergency polytrauma stabilization, complex intra-articular fractures, and limb reconstruction at BMTC Kidwai Nagar with modular OTs.

### 4.7 Slip Disc & Sciatica Spine Care
- Evidence-based non-surgical decompression, targeted epidural nerve blocks, and structured core stabilization physiotherapy for low back and radiating leg pain.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions & Clinical Facts

1. **How to book a consultation with Dr. Gaurav Bhargava?**
   Patients can book online at https://jointclinic.in/appointment or message via WhatsApp / phone at +91 73090 38872.

2. **Does Joint Clinic offer second opinions?**
   Yes. Patients with previous X-rays, MRI scans, or surgical recommendations are encouraged to schedule an evaluation to confirm surgical indications or explore conservative joint preservation.

3. **Can both knees be replaced at the same time (Bilateral TKR)?**
   Simultaneous bilateral TKR is evaluated on a case-by-case basis depending on cardiac status, physiological reserve, and hemoglobin levels. In eligible candidates, single-stage bilateral surgery allows a single hospital stay and unified rehabilitation period.

4. **Are emergency trauma cases handled around the clock?**
   Yes. Bhargava Medical & Trauma Centre (BMTC) in Kidwai Nagar operates a 24/7 dedicated trauma unit with emergency fracture care and surgical stabilization.
